full_judgment:
Gour Gopal Saha, J:- This is a prayer for bail in a case under sections 302/34 of the Penal Code pending before the 3rd Court of Additional Sessions Judge, Comilla Sessions Case No. 204 of 2001. 

 3. Mr. S.M. Aminur Rahim, the learned Assistant Attorney General appearing for the State, opposes the prayer for bail contending inter alia that the accused petitioner on fraudulent suppression of material facts obtained ad-interim bail from this Court on 20.3.2001 and as such the rule should be discharged and the order of ad-interim bail cancelled. The learned Assistant Attorney General further submits that the trial of the case is going on in the Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge, 3rd Court, Comilla and the trial is expected to be concluded soon, and in such circumstances, the petitioner should not be enlarged on bail. 

 4. We have gone through the case records. It is found from Annexure-A, certified copy of the FIR of the case that the name of accused petitioner Delwar Hossain was deliberately left out in it in order to facilitate his bail. We have compared Annexure-"A" of this case with the certified copy of the FIR marked as Annexure-"A" in the application for bail in Criminal Misc Case No. 2865 of 2002 arising out of selfsame case. In this FIR used in Criminal Misc. Case No. 2865 of 2002 the name of accused petitioner Delwar Hossain is found clearly mentioned at serial No. 2 along with the names of the 2 other accused persons, namely Feroz and Khokon, calling out deceased Parul Akhtar before killing her. The absence of the name of accused petitioner Delwar Hossain in the certified copy of the FIR marked Annexure-"A" to the application for bail in the present case, purported to have been supplied by the office of the Magistrate, Class, Comilla appears to us as an act of deliberate mischief for facilitating bail of accused petitioner Delwar Hossain. It is due to the absence of the name of accused petitioner Delwar Hossain in the certified copy of the FIR that might heavily weighed in the mind of the learned Judges in granting the petitioner ad-interim bail. 

 6. In the facts of the case, we are of the view that accused petitioner Delwar Hossain resorted to suppression of material facts and used a fake and incomplete FIR in the case in his bid to obtain bail from this Court. 

 9. Let a notice be issued to deponent Md. Jahangir Alam son of Md. Idrish Ali of 28, Azimpur Road, P.S. Lalbagh, Dhaka calling upon him to show cause as to why appropriate legal action shall not be taken against him for using a false and incomplete FIR before this court in connection with Criminal Misc. Case No. 1662 of 2001, arising out of Daudkandi P.S Case No. 9 dated 14.7.99, corresponding to G.R. Case No. 181 of 1999 under sections 302/34 of the Penal Code. His reply must reach this Court within seven days from the date of receipt of the notice, failing which appropriate legal action shall be taken against him. 

 10. The District Magistrate, Comilla is hereby directed to hold an immediate inquiry into the matter to find out the persons responsible for supplying the certified copy of an incomplete FIR marked as Annexure-"A" to the petition in Criminal Misc. Case No. 1661 of 2001 and to take appropriate action against the delinquents. He is further directed to report compliance of this order to this Court without 2 months from the date of receipt of the order. 

 11. The office is directed to send alongwith this order the certified copies of the FIR, marked as Annexure "A" in Criminal Misc. Case No. 1662 of 2001 and the certified copy of the FIR marked as Annexure-"A" in Criminal Misc. Case No. 2865 of 2002 to the District Magistrate, Comilla, by replacing these by the attested true copies thereof, to be attested by an officer of this Court.
